# FediSuite 1.7.0 is here!

## This release brings some of the biggest additions yet for publishing and analytics:

- Archive search: Search every post FediSuite has ever seen for your accounts. Search a single account or all connected accounts at once, with matches even inside words.
- Cross-posting: Select multiple accounts in the composer and publish or schedule the same post across different platforms. FediSuite automatically respects character limits, media rules, visibility options and other restrictions of all selected accounts.
- Eight new reach insights: FediSuite now uses calculated net reach directly to identify your best times and weekdays, differences between media and text posts, potential reach decline and more.
- The reach formula developed by Ralf Stockmann for FediWings now also includes quotes from Mastodon 4.5+. FediWings is also explicitly acknowledged within FediSuite as its sister project.

Plus several bug fixes and smaller improvements.

FediSuite is open source, self-hostable and licensed under GPL-3.0.

https://www.fedisuite.com
